groups.name: typed syntax and exhaustive bounded grammar
groups.domain: All 3960 generated ASTs with 3 or 5 nodes, six integer atoms, +/min/max and five comparisons.

groups.name: feature obstruction and finite synthesis receipt
groups.domain: All 198 prefixes with capacity 1,2,4 and total size 2..2c; all programs preceding the first passing AST.

groups.name: prefix capacity against literal binary completions
groups.domain: Every binary prefix and all remaining suffixes for total sizes 2..8, all integer capacities ceil(m/2)..8.

groups.name: streaming search matches exact compiler on every small binary table pair
groups.domain: n=1..4, every ordered pair of total immutable binary tables, horizon ceil(log2 n); independent parent frontier.

groups.name: lowering preserves the pure formula under its loop invariant
groups.domain: Every prior prefix with counts 0..c at capacities 1..32, each possible next binary report.

groups.name: literal repair-cover obstruction under immutable experiments
groups.domain: n=1..3, every nonempty family of one or two nonempty repair-success sets; every binary query; horizons 0,1,2.

groups.name: reject unsupported scope and preserve general fallback

groups.name: capacity feasibility is not actual query-library solvability
groups.domain: Four cases with one 2/2 split and singleton repairs; two- and three-step horizons; equality-only fallback.

groups.name: finite agreement does not license an unbounded pruning formula
groups.domain: Capped predicate on all 198 training contexts, then explicit c=8 counterexample; structural certificate gate.

groups.name: pure-data parser and untrusted-certificate negative controls
groups.domain: Wrong types, executable names, duplicate operands, nested comparisons, invalid engine, empty/out-of-range supports.

groups.name: input-read caps do not become false infeasibility certificates
groups.domain: Every cap 0..66 for the four-case model; compare exact same methods without caps.

groups.name: fresh finite families, supplementary work, and saved-row identity
groups.domain: Powers of two 2..64; both expression engines; read savings versus the same full-scan search, not processor speed.

groups.name: state-label and report-label transport with altered input order

groups.name: nonpower supports, downstream failures, and witness integrity
groups.domain: Every nonempty subset of the eight-case model, h=ceil(log2 support); corrupt each field in a returned four-case witness.
